title: KVRLootChest
description: This plugin adds a custom chest event. There are three tiers of loot in the chests. The chest spawns within a 2000 block radius of the spawn point. To open it, you need to kill the boss (a zombie in diamond armor with a sword and 100 HP).
body: This plugin adds a custom chest event. There are three tiers of loot in the chests. The chest spawns within a 2000 block radius of the spawn point. To open it, you need to kill the boss (a zombie in diamond armor with a sword and 100 HP). After killing the boss, you'll need to wait two minutes for the chest to unlock. After opening it, you'll have one minute to loot everything.
